title: VA rating decision letter (21 October 2015)
citation: U.S. Department of Veterans Affairs, rating decision letter to Larry D. Hunnewell, 21 October 2015. Family copy, scanned August 2026.
notes: Scanned 2026-08-15 in the same PDF as the clear copy of the DD-214. The letter and the VA file number are kept in the family's private archive (private/documents/va/ — gitignored) per project policy; the file number goes directly onto records-request forms. Research value: (1) supplies the VA claim/file number for SF-180 item 9; (2) the VA claims file (C-file) it points to typically contains copies of service and medical records gathered for adjudication — a second records target alongside NPRC; (3) among the rated conditions is an Agent Orange presumptive condition, which required the VA to verify in-country Vietnam service — independent official corroboration of the tour. (Specific conditions are recorded only in the private archive.) Non-identifying findings: research/records-request/dd214-findings.md.
